mathematical_audit.sublinear_depth: When B=o(M), both retained endpoints remain fixed positive multiples of M. Two ordinary prime-number-theorem estimates give retained mass M/6+o(M), so the excluded strip has only o(M) logarithmic mass; no short-interval theorem is used.
